system.description:
Make an Interface Roll (13).
On a success, spend 2 Hope to deploy
a survival bunker, natural barricade,
scrap dome, hard-shell shelter,
emergency cover, or rapid-build
defensive structure that you and one
ally can take cover within.
While inside the bunker, a creature
can’t be targeted by attacks and can’t
make attacks.
Attacks made against the bunker
automatically succeed.
The bunker has the following damage
thresholds and lasts until it marks 3 Hit
Points. Place tokens on this card to
represent marking Hit Points.
Thresholds: 15/30
